record.name: Albania
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The agency AKSHI has an AI Directorate and describes a national AI strategy and methodology and alignment with the EU AI Act, but no testing or safety body.

related_bodies.name: AKSHI AI Directorate
related_bodies.role: It works on public-sector AI and EU alignment. It is part of the National Agency for Information Society. No model-evaluation mandate was stated.

next_check.reason: Check for an AI law or authority.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. English search excerpts pointed to an official AI draft-law consultation and strategy planning, without a qualifying institute or institute-specific commitment. Those newly surfaced pages were not opened in this pass. The selected AKSHI governance page and its fallback text copy were inaccessible, so no fresh reading of that source is claimed. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded sq query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: AKSHI describes the national AI strategy and AI governance methodology, including alignment with the EU AI Act; a generic site-search page is not the substantive evidence.

record.notes: Albania's AI minister 'Diella' (an AI system in the public procurement role) was not verified here and is not an institute. Evidence is from AKSHI pages only.
